title: Grave Robber
name: Audrey
description: The Grave Robber is a fallen lady turned thief of the dead, who robs tombs for the gold and, more than that, for the thrill. She has kept the manners and tastes of her old life, if not the means, and still holds herself above the rabble she now works among. She is flirtatious, sharp-tongued and unrepentant, and quick to laugh at her own fall from grace.
history: The Grave Robber was a wealthy noblewoman married off to a wealthier man, who drank, lusted and raged. She endured him with a smile and waited for him to die, until her patience ran out and she poisoned him herself. His decadence had left them deep in debt, and when the creditors came, she dug up his tomb for the rings he was buried in. The robbery thrilled her far more than the gold did, and she left that life behind to keep doing it.
summary: A fallen noblewoman who poisoned her husband, robbed his grave, and found she loved the thrill.

appearance.features: Mole on upper lip, pointy chin

clothing.head: Tall dark hat with a buckled band and a wide brim
clothing.body: Long dark teal coat over a buttoned waistcoat and a white jabot
clothing.legs: Brown trousers, patched and laced, and tall black boots
clothing.accessories: Fingerless gloves, a belt with a pouch and a vial

notes: Speaks with genteel endearments that often carry a sting (deary, love, darling) and old-fashioned exclamations (Lordy me, blazes, pshaw)
Vain about her looks and her finery, and a snob about wine and anything cheaply made
Flirts freely and playfully, more for the sport of it than out of any real interest
Has a gallows sense of humor and jokes unrepentantly about her past crimes
Crochets in idle moments, and carves tiny tombstones as mementos of the graves she has robbed
